theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let S := (fun (g : C) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
  have hS : S.Nonempty := ⟨_, ⟨⟨0, C.zero_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem hS
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let B := fun (y : sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩) => Finset.univ.image (qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
    (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) y)
  letI : Fintype Y := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have hcard : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    refine (Finset.card_le_card (t := Y.toFinset.biUnion B) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro x hx
      have hx' : f x ≠ g.val x := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      let y := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y, Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, hx'⟩, ?_⟩
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) steps h_i_add_steps x,
        Finset.mem_univ _, ?_⟩
      exact (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x y).mp rfl
    · apply Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans
      calc
        ∑ y ∈ Y.toFinset, (B y).card ≤ ∑ y ∈ Y.toFinset, 2 ^ steps := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro y hy
          exact (Finset.card_image_le).trans_eq (Fintype.card_fin _)
        _ = _ := by simp only [sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, ←Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  have hb : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    change 2 * (↑(sInf S) : ℕ∞) < _ at h_fw_dist_lt
    rw [←hg] at h_fw_dist_lt
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hid : (BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩ - 1) * 2 ^ steps =
      BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add]
    congr 2 <;> omega
  have hnat : 2 * hammingDist f g < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
    have h := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hcard)
    rw [←mul_assoc] at h
    have h' := h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hb)
    rw [hid] at h'
    have hp : 0 < BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩ := by
      unfold BBF_CodeDistance
      omega
    omega
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  exact_mod_cast hnat
